sources.title: Megapack 2 XL Datasheet, Rev. 1.5.1, 10 February 2023

locators.locator: p.1, POWER AND ENERGY table
locators.supports: B-01-01, B-03-03: a commercial unit at exactly 2.000 h duration (3854/1927)

locators.locator: p.1, ELECTRICAL, Round-Trip Efficiency footnote 2 (full-depth cycle including all power conversion and thermal system losses, at 25 C)
locators.supports: B-03-01: RTE upper end of the observed range

locators.locator: p.1, WARRANTY
locators.quote: Term 15 years standard, extendable to 20 years
locators.supports: B-04-01: baseline life choice and 20-year sensitivity

locators.locator: p.1, ELECTRICAL, inverter note 1
locators.quote: Scalable from 400 kVA minimum in increments of 50 kVA
locators.supports: B-01-02: module grid and partial-unit flexibility

locators.supports: B-04-04: all-in O&M, conflicting with PNNL's 0.43% of capex

locators.locator: p.22, Table 4.4 'Li-ion DC-DC and AC-AC RTE Values'
locators.quote_provenance: helper-extracted from the PDF; not independently re-read verbatim by me
locators.supports: B-03-01: conservative whole-plant AC-AC efficiency end

locators.locator: p.22, Table 4.3 cycle life
locators.quote: LFP 2,400 cycles and NMC 1,520 cycles at 80% average DOD to the halfway state-of-health point
locators.quote_provenance: helper-extracted; not independently re-read verbatim by me
locators.supports: B-04-02, B-04-03: cycle budget versus daily cycling

locators.locator: p.22, warranty practice discussion
locators.quote: warranties noted as typically limiting users to one full 100% DOD-equivalent cycle per day
locators.quote_provenance: helper-extracted; not independently re-read verbatim by me
locators.supports: B-04-03: the one-cycle-per-day convention

locators.locator: p.17-19, fixed O&M and refurbishment assumptions; p.21-22 augmentation and life
locators.quote: Fixed O&M = 0.43% of direct capital cost ... approximately $4.59/kW-year for a 10 MW, 4-hour system
locators.quote_provenance: helper-extracted; not independently re-read verbatim by me
locators.supports: B-04-04, B-04-06: bottom-up O&M and 10-year power-equipment refurbishment

sources.limitations: US 2021/2030 modelling assumptions, not UK 2026 market prices. All four values in this entry were obtained through a read_with_purpose helper over my own captured copy of the PDF, so the wording is reported rather than verified character by character; the page and table locators are recorded so a reviewer can check them in one step.

sources.title: Project_Brief.pdf, page 3 and Appendix page 6 (text extract supplied in the input bundle)

locators.locator: p.3 and p.6, battery parameters
locators.quote: Assume 90% roundtrip efficiency and that normally only 20%-80% of the battery's total capacity is used.
locators.quote_provenance: supplied text extract in the input bundle
locators.supports: B-03-01, B-03-04: the reference efficiency and SOC window

locators.locator: p.6, Battery investment cost row
locators.quote: EUR 0.288m per MWh ... Multiply installed battery energy capacity by this figure to estimate investment cost.
locators.quote_provenance: supplied text extract in the input bundle
locators.supports: B-02-02: the value whose reproducibility I tested against DEA

sources.limitations: The brief is a requirement, not market evidence. It does not state a price year, currency base year or cost-scope boundary for the 0.288 figure, which is precisely why the DEA reconstruction matters.
